deviations_from_card: Coupled file outside write_set: apps/console/budgets/bundle.json (taken under the lock; the lock had been held 10+ min and was removed as stale per the brief). Lines raised, measured against a HEAD build of the same tree: onair.l1 css 24,500 -> 25,000 (~24,170 -> 24,893 B), onair.l2 js 102,000 -> 103,000 (~101,580 -> 102,531 B), onair.l2 css 21,000 -> 21,500 (~20,790 -> 21,254 B); $comment extended. Moment ticks are binned (exact at 0.5% resolution, coarsened to at most 12 when a run marks more places) because src/perf/dom.test.tsx caps onair.l1 at 260 nodes (measured 239); a 100k-line testdata transcript has 10k mark_moment ops. 'Replay on screen' now plays from the run's start (the premise's resume-wherever-it-was case). Layer1 inlines an m:ss formatter instead of importing kit/events, which pulled ~6 KB into onair.l1 js.
notes: 10 cases red before (7 card + seek clamp + LiveFeed seek no-op + the 100k DOM case extension), all green after; full console suite 468 passed. The two commits are seek (player/feed + unit tests + budget) and UI (scrubber, beat/span jumps + DOM tests); tests were committed with the implementation because they do not typecheck without seek. Working tree carries a sibling's uncommitted packages/contract changes (not mine); my build ran with them present.
